title: Emiko Mido's Secret
teaser: After inadvertently walking in on Emiko Mido's most private postoperative secret in an empty operating room, Ryuji refuses to use it against her in the Chief of Surgery race—and is invited behind her closed OR door for the first time.
gallery_caption: Having refused to exploit Emiko Mido's secret in the Chief of Surgery rivalry, Ryuji Sakaguchi is asked to stay behind in Operating Room No. 2 after their next laparotomy—sharing her secret on the operating table without yielding half a step in their competition.

choices.choice_em4_c1_a: "Precisely because I want to be Chief of Surgery, I intend to settle it with you at the operating table on real skill."
choices.choice_em4_c1_b: "Pushing a rival out by tattling? Even if I took the Chief's chair that way, I'd be disgusted looking at myself."
choices.choice_em4_c1_c: "You think too highly of cheap tricks like that, Chief Mido. The one I want to beat is you with a scalpel in your hand."
choices.choice_em4_c2_a: "Not in the slightest. Knowing the impeccable Chief Mido has desires this honest actually makes you far more appealing than before."
choices.choice_em4_c2_b: "As for being surprised, I used up my quota in that one second at the door. Looking down on you? None of this conflicts with how brilliant you are at the table."
choices.choice_em4_c2_c: "Loving surgery and choosing how you unwind after stepping off the table are entirely your own business. To me, you're still the partner I respect most."

prompts.em4_c1_prompt: How will Ryuji answer Emiko's challenge over exploiting her secret in the Chief of Surgery race?
prompts.em4_c2_prompt: How will Ryuji answer Emiko's candid question—"Do you really not look down on me?"

nodes.em4_s1_01: Just past six in the evening, the fourth-floor surgical corridor had already fallen quiet.
nodes.em4_s1_02: That afternoon's lengthy combined resection had wrapped up smoothly twenty minutes earlier; the ward nurses had already settled the patient back into bed, and the instrument carts had long since been wheeled into central sterile supply.
nodes.em4_s1_03: Only after changing back into his white coat and stepping up to the specimen registry desk did Ryuji Sakaguchi notice a blank line on the reverse of the histopathology requisition—missing the lead surgeon's supplementary anatomical localization signature. Remembering Emiko Mido's habit of lingering in the operating room to finish her notes last, he tucked the form and his fountain pen under his arm and turned back toward Operating Room No. 2.
nodes.em4_s1_04: Above the door, the red "IN SURGERY" indicator had long since gone dark.
nodes.em4_s1_05: Without overthinking it, Ryuji tapped the doorframe once with his knuckles as the tip of his shoe brushed the foot-sensor plate beside the threshold—
nodes.em4_s1_07: The heavy automatic door glided smoothly open along its track.
nodes.em4_s1_08: Half a step past the threshold, Ryuji froze dead in his tracks.
nodes.em4_s1_09: The glaring overhead surgical lamps had been switched off, leaving only the cool, recessed perimeter strips glowing softly around the room. At the center of the silent, empty theater, leaning half-reclined against the padded steel edge of the operating table—already stripped of drapes and wiped spotless—was a nearly naked figure.
nodes.em4_s1_11: The Surgical Chief who ordinarily buttoned even the collar of her white coat with fastidious precision had long since shed every piece of sterile gear. Her scrub pants had been stripped completely off and draped over a low stool beside her feet, her long, pale thighs parted bare against the cool rim of the operating table; her dark scrub top had been shoved all the way up past her chin, exposing the full curve of her snow-white breasts rising and falling with ragged breaths.
nodes.em4_s1_12: In an empty operating room quiet enough to hear the hum of the ventilation ducts, her flushed, fever-warm throat was tilted back—one hand kneading her bare breast, fingertips sinking deep into the soft flesh, while the other hand worked rapidly between her slick thighs, damp, trembling gasps slipping past her tightly bitten lips:
nodes.em4_s1_14: The rush of air from the sliding door broke the sealed stillness of the room.
nodes.em4_s1_15: The hurried wet sounds and breathless gasps cut off at once.
nodes.em4_s1_16: Emiko's eyes snapped wide—still glistening with moisture and dazed heat—and she whipped her head around, locking gazes with Ryuji Sakaguchi standing a single pace inside the doorway.
nodes.em4_s1_17: One second. Perhaps less than a second.
nodes.em4_s1_18: Both of them saw the other's face with unmistakable clarity, and both knew beyond a shadow of a doubt—every detail of that scene had just been seen in full, leaving zero room to pass it off as "changing clothes" or "sorting instruments."
nodes.em4_s1_19: The flush drained from Emiko's face to stark white in an instant, then surged right back up to the tips of her ears in sheer shock and mortification. Recoiling as though struck by lightning, she yanked her bunched scrub top down over her chest, spine stiffening against the edge of the operating table; her voice trembled faintly from the sudden loss of control, yet lashed out cold and sharp as a blade:
nodes.em4_s1_21: Ryuji did not linger for even a fraction of a glance, nor utter a single flippant syllable.
nodes.em4_s1_23: Withdrawing his foot at once, he stepped outside and pressed the exterior close button.
nodes.em4_s1_24: The heavy metal door slid swiftly shut along its rail and latched with a solid click, sealing away the suddenly unsteady breathing inside.
nodes.em4_s1_25: Standing alone beneath the empty corridor lights, Ryuji glanced down at the unsigned pathology slip in his hand, let out a long, quiet breath, and turned away from the fourth floor.
nodes.em4_s2_01: Over the next two days, on the surface, nothing whatsoever changed in Hoshimi Hospital's Department of Surgery.
nodes.em4_s2_02: At the next morning's handover conference, Emiko Mido took her seat at the long table right on time. Her long hair was still smoothed into neat, poised order, her white coat crisp and spotless; as she presented critical cases and postoperative labs, her logic was razor-clear and her judgment exact, without a single missed figure or the faintest trace of distraction.
nodes.em4_s2_03: Yet when the morning conference adjourned and staff passed one another in the second-floor hallway—
nodes.em4_s2_04: Coming face-to-face with Emiko carrying a stack of charts, Ryuji slowed his step:
nodes.em4_s2_06: Emiko's gaze skimmed past the line of his shoulder for the briefest instant without meeting his eyes, and she gave a cool, impeccably polite nod:
nodes.em4_s2_08: Before the words had fully faded, she had already walked straight past him with her posture ramrod straight, leaving not even half a second for small talk.
nodes.em4_s2_09: By the afternoon of the second day, in front of the fourth-floor OR scheduling whiteboard, that deliberate distance grew unmistakable.
nodes.em4_s2_10: The following morning had a redo laparotomy scheduled with dense adhesions; given the chemistry the two of them had built at the CABG table not long ago, Emiko leading with Ryuji as first assistant would ordinarily have been the most natural pairing.
nodes.em4_s2_11: Yet as Ryuji walked past the whiteboard, he saw Emiko uncapping a marker and writing another surgeon's name cleanly into the "First Assistant" column.
nodes.em4_s2_12: Catching his footsteps behind her, Emiko clicked the cap back onto the marker and, without waiting for him to ask, offered an airtight professional explanation:
nodes.em4_s2_13: "There are adhesions on this case, yes, but nothing that requires tying up two senior leads at once. You have outpatient follow-ups that morning anyway, so I'll use the slot to sharpen another surgeon's table rhythm."
nodes.em4_s2_14: Sound reasoning, sensible staffing, not a single flaw by clinical standards—yet it cleanly severed any chance of the two of them being left alone inside the same operating room.
nodes.em4_s2_15: Looking at the neat handwriting on the board, Ryuji didn't call her on it, simply nodding calmly:
nodes.em4_s2_16: "Understood. Whatever works best for your schedule."
nodes.em4_s2_17: Emiko's knuckles tightened almost imperceptibly around the marker; she murmured a low "Mm" and turned toward the wards.
nodes.em4_s2_18: It was the same during evening ward rounds on the third day.
nodes.em4_s2_19: So long as nurses or other doctors were present, she remained the decisive, commanding Surgical Chief who held the entire department in awe; the instant the corridor emptied to just the two of them, the air tautened into a sheet of hard ice.
nodes.em4_s2_20: Ryuji could read the tension beneath that frost—
nodes.em4_s2_21: For a woman proud to the marrow of her bones and pouring everything she had into the Chief of Surgery race, suddenly handing fatal leverage to a rival surgeon meant bracing every waking moment for him to detonate it—and deeper still beneath that guard lay another tremor she would never willingly admit.
nodes.em4_s2_22: Still, the stalemate did not last long.
nodes.em4_s2_23: Because Emiko Mido had never been a woman to curl into a shell and passively await someone else's verdict.
nodes.em4_s3_01: At seven-thirty in the evening, only the quiet tap of keystrokes remained in the surgical doctors' office.
nodes.em4_s3_02: The last junior doctor off the day shift slung his bag over his shoulder, bade goodnight, and pulled the office door shut behind him. Ryuji finished saving a discharge summary and was just about to shut down his workstation when a chair scraped back behind the desk by the window.
nodes.em4_s3_03: Emiko Mido—who had been reviewing charts in silence—rose to her feet, bypassed the trench coat hanging on the rack, and walked with steady, measured steps straight up to Ryuji's desk.
nodes.em4_s3_06: With both hands resting at the sides of her white coat, Emiko looked straight down into his eyes. She didn't circle the subject for a breath, her voice low, cold, and taut as though braced to take the worst head-on:
nodes.em4_s3_07: "How long do you plan on dragging this out?"
nodes.em4_s3_10: Emiko's brow creased, her gaze cold as tempered ice:
nodes.em4_s3_11: "Don't play dumb with me, Sakaguchi. Nobody else is in this room."
nodes.em4_s3_12: Drawing a slow breath, she dragged the thorn straight out into the open word by word:
nodes.em4_s3_13: "Three evenings ago in Operating Room Two—what you saw when you opened that door. When are you planning to use it? Or rather, what are your terms?"
nodes.em4_s3_14: Ryuji leaned back against his chair, studying the taut line of her profile quietly:
nodes.em4_s3_15: "In your eyes, am I really the sort of man who blackmails a colleague over a minor thing like that?"
nodes.em4_s3_16: Emiko let out a cold laugh, her tone razor-edged and direct:
nodes.em4_s3_17: "It's hardly a minor thing. The whole hospital is talking about the vacant Chief of Surgery post. I'm qualified to contend for it, and I intend to fight all the way to the end. One casual remark from you to Director Shiromiya—that the Surgical Chief uses an operating room to gratify desires like that after stepping off the table—and even without a formal reprimand, I couldn't show my face on the shortlist again."
nodes.em4_s3_18: Her eyes locked onto Ryuji with an almost all-or-nothing pride:
nodes.em4_s3_19: "If you have your sights on that chair too, you could clear your most troublesome rival off the board without lifting a finger. Anyone playing to win would have made their move already, wouldn't they?"
nodes.em4_c1a_01: Ryuji rose to his feet, meeting the prickly woman's gaze at eye level, his voice calm without a trace of jest:
nodes.em4_c1a_02: "I won't deny I'm interested in the Chief of Surgery post. But precisely because I want that chair, I want to settle it with you fair and square at the operating table—on real surgical skill."
nodes.em4_c1a_03: Emiko's breath hitched faintly, her pupils contracting a fraction:
nodes.em4_c1b_01: Ryuji rose to his feet and shook his head with a wry exhale:
nodes.em4_c1b_02: "Squeezing a rival out by running to the director with gossip? If that's how someone claims the Chief of Surgery chair at Hoshimi Hospital, they can keep the title—I'd be disgusted just looking at myself."
nodes.em4_c1b_03: As though her rigid, braced guard had swung straight into empty air, Emiko froze:
nodes.em4_c1c_01: Ryuji rose to his feet, meeting her piercing gaze with an unguarded smile:
nodes.em4_c1c_02: "You think far too highly of off-the-table tricks, Chief Mido. I didn't come to Hoshimi Surgery to play office politics—if we're settling who wins, the one I want to beat is you standing under the surgical lamp with a scalpel in your hand."
nodes.em4_c1c_03: Staring into the candor in his eyes, Emiko momentarily forgot to answer:
nodes.em4_c1c_04: "…Me with a scalpel in my hand?"
nodes.em4_s3r_01: Emiko stared hard at Ryuji's face, as though searching his eyes for some calculated ploy or patronizing charity.
nodes.em4_s3r_02: Yet there was no calculation there at all—no smugness at holding leverage, no slyness waiting to name a price, not even the faintest trace of the mockery she had braced for from someone who had seen her undone.
nodes.em4_s3r_03: Silence held the office for a full three or four seconds.
nodes.em4_s3r_04: Emiko's lips parted slightly before the words escaped her in genuine, unvarnished disbelief:
nodes.em4_s3r_07: "How do I refrain from reporting you and end up getting insulted for it?"
nodes.em4_s3r_08: "Tell Asuka what you saw that evening and I can barely stay in the race against you. An opening that clean drops right into your lap, and you just let it go for nothing?"
nodes.em4_s3r_09: Ryuji let his smile fade, looking at her in earnest:
nodes.em4_s3r_10: "Because I want the post, I want to know which of us actually belongs in it. If I forced you out over something that pointless, what would even be worth competing for?"
nodes.em4_s3r_12: The taut wire that had hung over her head for three straight days gave way without warning. Shifting her gaze half an inch aside from his overly direct eyes, her chest rose and fell once before she forced out stiffly under her breath:
nodes.em4_s3r_14: Right on its heels came a murmur pitched so low and light it nearly vanished into the hum of the air conditioner:
nodes.em4_s3r_16: Lifting one brow, Ryuji leaned half an inch closer on purpose:
nodes.em4_s3r_17: "Hm? What were those last two words just now?"
nodes.em4_s3r_18: A thin flush crept instantly up the tips of Emiko's ears, and she schooled her face into frost and turned her head away:
nodes.em4_s3r_19: "If you missed it, forget it. I'm not saying it twice."
nodes.em4_s3r_20: Watching the ordinarily imperious Surgical Chief resort to rare, stubborn deflection, Ryuji held back a grin and—rather than teasing her further—shifted tone with a practical word from one insider to another:
nodes.em4_s3r_21: "That said, not reporting it is one thing—there is still one point I ought to remind you about."
nodes.em4_s3r_23: "…Planning to lecture me on operating-room rules?"
nodes.em4_s3r_24: "I have zero interest in giving you a hospital ethics sermon. I mean your timing was way too dicey."
nodes.em4_s3r_25: He gestured upstairs toward the surgical suite, his tone candid to the point of dry amusement:
nodes.em4_s3r_26: "Barely fifteen minutes after the patient wheels out, a circulating nurse could double back any second for a forgotten chart binder, an orderly could come in early to mop, or someone like me could return with an unsigned pathology slip. Run into any one of them, given your standing as Surgical Chief and Chief candidate—whoever's standing in that doorway might not be half as easygoing as I am. Imagine how awkward that scene would get."
nodes.em4_s3r_27: Having braced herself for a sanctimonious lecture, Emiko hadn't expected his sole concern to be keeping her from getting caught in an impossible spot.
nodes.em4_s3r_28: Heat rose across her cheeks, and she shot him a look half mortified, half exasperated:
nodes.em4_s3r_29: "…That's none of your concern! That evening was only… the afternoon resection went too cleanly, and in the rush of it I forgot to throw the interior lock, that's all!"
nodes.em4_s4_01: The moment that excuse slipped out, the air in the office shifted subtly.
nodes.em4_s4_02: Every trace of the past two days' drawn-blade wariness had dissolved, replaced by the quiet of finally brushing against the heart of her secret.
nodes.em4_s4_03: Emiko did not turn to leave right away. She stood silent beside the desk for a moment, as if weighing just how much candor the man before her could take; after a few seconds, she pulled over a swivel chair instead, sat down, folded her arms lightly across her chest, and met Ryuji's eyes.
nodes.em4_s4_04: "…Since you've already seen it, there's no point insulting your intelligence with the 'staying behind to finish operative notes' excuse anymore."
nodes.em4_s4_05: Ryuji settled back into his own chair as well, listening quietly.
nodes.em4_s4_06: Emiko's voice regained its usual cool clarity, only the faint pink at the tips of her ears betraying how much nerve it took to dissect so private a habit aloud to a man:
nodes.em4_s4_07: "It's been like this for years. The harder the case—the less room there is for even half a millimeter's mistake—the moment that final knot seats home and a dangerous field settles completely under my own hands… the rush in my head simply refuses to shut off."
nodes.em4_s4_08: Her fingertips brushed lightly against the cuff of her white coat, her tone forthright and proud, without a shred of self-pitying pathology:
nodes.em4_s4_09: "My pulse stays racing, every nerve in my body humming as if live current just ran through it… Once the patient and nurses are gone and I'm standing alone in the operating room I just won, that high turns straight into an overwhelming… physical urge."
nodes.em4_s4_10: Emiko lifted her eyes to Ryuji:
nodes.em4_s4_11: "I don't consider it an illness that needs curing, and I have no intention of changing it. I love performing high-difficulty operations, and after a surgery succeeds, I like making myself feel good like that alone in an empty operating room."
nodes.em4_s4_13: The fearless poise she had worn while arguing over the Chief's post softened by a fraction, and into those cool, clear eyes crept a tentative probe that mattered more to her than she cared to show:
nodes.em4_s4_14: "…Tell me the truth. Don't you find me strange?"
nodes.em4_s4_15: "The Surgical Chief who holds everyone in the department to such unforgiving standards, stripping her clothes off behind closed doors to touch herself in an operating room right after surgery… Knowing I'm that kind of woman, do you really not look down on me?"
nodes.em4_s4_16: So over these past three days, losing her shot at Chief had never been the only thing she was afraid of.
nodes.em4_c2a_01: Looking into her taut eyes, Ryuji answered openly, a warm trace of a smile at the corner of his mouth:
nodes.em4_c2a_02: "Not in the slightest. Watching you around the department before, you always seemed like a scalpel kept sheathed from morning till night; finding out the untouchable Chief Mido has desires that fierce and that honest makes you seem far more vivid—and far easier on the eyes."
nodes.em4_c2a_03: Emiko blinked, her cheeks warming faintly as she turned her head aside with a soft scoff:
nodes.em4_c2a_04: "…What's 'easier on the eyes' supposed to mean? You make it sound as if I were unbearable before."
nodes.em4_c2a_05: For all the bite in her words, her tense shoulders visibly eased.
nodes.em4_c2b_01: Ryuji gave an easy shrug, his voice light and candid:
nodes.em4_c2b_02: "I'd be lying if I said I wasn't surprised at all—but I used up my entire quota of surprise during that one second at the door. As for looking down on you? How you choose to enjoy yourself after stepping off the table doesn't conflict one bit with how steady and commanding your hands are during surgery."
nodes.em4_c2b_03: At the mention of that split second at the door, Emiko's face flared crimson and she shot him an incensed glare:
nodes.em4_c2b_04: "You are forbidden from bringing up that doorway scene again!"
nodes.em4_c2b_05: Ryuji raised both hands in surrender:
nodes.em4_c2b_07: Emiko let out a long breath, the very last trace of wariness in her eyes dissolving with that exchange.
nodes.em4_c2c_01: Meeting her gaze, Ryuji answered with calm sincerity:
nodes.em4_c2c_02: "Pushing every operation to perfection and choosing your own way to release the adrenaline afterward is nobody's business but yours—and it has never compromised a single patient. In my eyes, you're still the same Emiko Mido across the table whom I trust completely and never dare underestimate."
nodes.em4_c2c_03: Emiko studied him in silence for several seconds, the sharp guard in her eyes melting bit by bit into a rare softness:
nodes.em4_c2c_04: "…For a man like you, the way you put things is surprisingly hard to dislike."
nodes.em4_s4r_01: Outside the window, the night breeze stirred the venetian blinds softly.
nodes.em4_s4r_02: Emiko lowered her lashes to look at her own long, steady fingers—the pair of hands Hoshimi Hospital prided itself on most, and the very same hands this man had caught touching her own body three evenings ago.
nodes.em4_s4r_03: In the past, the mere thought of anyone knowing would have made her skin crawl with discomfort.
nodes.em4_s4r_04: Yet sitting across from Ryuji Sakaguchi now—a surgeon whose skill held up, whose nerve held firm, and who met even her most private desires at level eye—she felt none of the humiliation she had braced for, only an unfamiliar lightness… and a faint, unexpected flicker of heat.
nodes.em4_s4r_05: Rising from the chair, Emiko smoothed the hem of her white coat and let her eyes rest on Ryuji's face once more:
nodes.em4_s4r_06: "…I've never told a soul about any of this before."
nodes.em4_s4r_07: She paused half a beat, her voice quiet yet crystal clear:
nodes.em4_s4r_08: "Still… if the one who knows is you, I suppose I don't mind."
nodes.em4_s4r_09: Seeing the luster return to her eyes, Ryuji stood with a smile:
nodes.em4_s4r_11: Walking to the office door, Emiko rested her hand on the lever and glanced back over her shoulder at him:
nodes.em4_s4r_12: "Day after tomorrow, morning slot in Operating Room Two—we have an elective open cholecystectomy. I'm not swapping anyone else in this time. You're scrubbing in as my first assistant."
nodes.em4_s5_01: Two mornings later in Operating Room No. 2, the surgical lamps cast a steady pool of light across a right subcostal incision.
nodes.em4_s5_02: After their candid showdown in the office two nights earlier, every trace of stiff distance between them had vanished. From skin incision to dissection of Calot's triangle and division of the cystic structures, two pairs of hands moved across the field more crisply than ever before, even their passing glances carrying an unspoken ease.
nodes.em4_s5_03: Once the distended gallbladder settled cleanly into the sterile kidney dish offered by Hiroko Sugimura, Ryuji irrigated the liver bed gently with warm saline, assisted Emiko in touching off the last pinpoint capillary ooze with electrocautery, and smoothly withdrew the warm saline laparotomy pad tucked beneath the liver to shield the duodenum and transverse colon, handing it back to the count zone to verify a clean field.
nodes.em4_s5_04: "Pre-closure count—protective laparotomy pad out; sponges, peanut swabs, needles, and all instruments verified correct in double count with Anji."
nodes.em4_s5_05: "Circulating log matches—all counts correct! Blood pressure one-eighteen over seventy-four, heart rate seventy-six, rock steady!"
nodes.em4_s5_06: Hearing the double-count callout from behind the ether screen, twenty-seven-year-old police officer Mayumi Sakurai—who had held her tongue the entire time under awake epidural anesthesia—finally let out half a breath and spoke up in her trademark brisk, tough-talking cadence:
nodes.em4_s5_07: "Hey, Docs, I just heard you finish counting all the sponges and gear—does that mean you're stitching my belly shut right away? Just so we're clear, I'm not rushing you 'cause it hurts; the traffic division folks back at the precinct are waiting on my all-clear to post next week's duty roster."
nodes.em4_s5_08: Running a continuous suture along the peritoneum without breaking wrist rhythm for an instant, Emiko answered briefly and decisively:
nodes.em4_s5_09: "The gallbladder is out clean; the peritoneum is closed and I'm approximating the anterior fascia now. Hold still—you'll be heading back to the ward in a few minutes."
nodes.em4_s5_10: Following the suture and snipping tails from across the table, Ryuji chimed in with a smile:
nodes.em4_s5_11: "Everything went smoothly, Ms. Sakurai. Though if you're hoping to be back on street patrol writing tickets next week, you'll have to clear that with our nurses first."
nodes.em4_s5_12: At the head of the table, Anji Tonegawa nodded earnestly in agreement:
nodes.em4_s5_13: "That's right! Your incision needs proper rest for the first few days post-op, so no toughing it out or running around the ward, Ms. Sakurai."
nodes.em4_s5_14: Behind the screen, Mayumi Sakurai gave a light scoff, though the relief in her voice was unmistakable:
nodes.em4_s5_15: "…Yeah, yeah, I hear you—I'm not some rogue driver ignoring traffic signals. Appreciate it today, Dr. Mido, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.em4_s5_16: Anterior fascia and subcutaneous tissue came together cleanly. As Hiroko Sugimura and Anji Tonegawa called out, "Final closing count—sponges, needles, and instruments all correct," Emiko tied off the final skin suture with crisp precision and laid down the sterile dressing.
nodes.em4_s5_17: The operation concluded without a hitch.
nodes.em4_s5_18: After carefully checking the epidural catheter fixation and IV line, Anji Tonegawa wheeled a well-recovering Mayumi Sakurai out toward the surgical ward for handover; Hiroko Sugimura consolidated the sealed specimen and instrument return cart, offered both surgeons a warm "Good work today," and rolled the cart out of Operating Room No. 2.
nodes.em4_s5_19: Standing beside the disposal bin, the two of them peeled off their outer sterile gowns and latex gloves in turn, untying their surgical masks.
nodes.em4_s5_20: The instant her mask fell away, Ryuji glanced sideways and caught sight of Emiko Mido beside him—
nodes.em4_s5_21: Even after a routine open procedure executed cleanly from start to finish, standing in the afterglow of the surgical lamps, those cool, piercing eyes of hers swam with that scorching, luminous sheen he now knew all too well. A faint flush tinted the pale curve of her neck and ears, her breathing half a beat quicker than usual.
nodes.em4_s5_22: Only this time, realizing Ryuji was looking at her, Emiko did not turn her back to hide it.
nodes.em4_s5_23: Noting her quickened breath and recalling their usual post-op routine, Ryuji spoke with an inquiring smile:
nodes.em4_s5_24: "The patient and instruments are all out. Should I head back to the office ahead of you like usual today?"
nodes.em4_s5_25: Standing beside the freshly wiped operating table, Emiko rested her long fingers lightly against the cool metal side rail.
nodes.em4_s5_26: She lifted her gaze straight to Ryuji, her throat moving ever so slightly as she broke her own rule aloud for the first time:
nodes.em4_s5_28: Ryuji halted and turned to face her.
nodes.em4_s5_29: Emiko's cheeks burned a shade deeper than a moment ago, yet her gaze was candid and searing, without an ounce of retreat:
nodes.em4_s5_30: "You don't have to leave first today."
nodes.em4_s5_31: Holding her eyes, Ryuji lowered his voice a notch:
nodes.em4_s5_32: "If I'm not leaving first—what would Chief Mido like me to do?"
nodes.em4_s5_33: Emiko caught the corner of her lip gently between her teeth, sounding half like an order and half like an invitation meant for his ears alone:
nodes.em4_s5_34: "…Stay. Keep me company for a little while."
nodes.em4_s5_35: Neither a trade for his silence nor an impulsive bid to please—once certain this man could hold both her fiercest pride and her deepest secret without prejudice, she was opening that locked operating-room door to him of her own accord for the very first time.
nodes.em4_s5_36: Looking into her shining eyes, Ryuji felt a quiet surge of warmth and answered with a steady, unhurried smile:
nodes.em4_s5_37: "Gladly. Though before I keep you company, let me step outside and give a quick word—we don't want anyone barging in on us for real."
nodes.em4_s5_40: Right on cue, brisk footsteps sounded down the corridor outside—fresh from settling Mayumi Sakurai safely into the ward, Anji Tonegawa was walking back up to Operating Room No. 2 with her circulating clipboard in hand to retrieve the chart folder left inside.
nodes.em4_s5_41: Stepping naturally into the half-open doorway, Ryuji met her at the threshold with an easy smile and took the folder from her hands:
nodes.em4_s5_42: "Thanks for handling the ward handover, Anji."
nodes.em4_s5_43: Anji halted politely with a nod:
nodes.em4_s5_44: "No trouble at all! Ms. Sakurai is all settled in. Dr. Sakaguchi, should I come in now to tidy up the circulating desk in Room Two?"
nodes.em4_s5_45: Without batting an eye, Ryuji smiled:
nodes.em4_s5_46: "No rush right now. Chief Mido and I had a few thoughts on some anatomical details from that case, and we'd like to stay in this room to debrief privately while it's fresh before heading out. Barring an emergency, could you keep everyone from coming in for the next half hour?"
nodes.em4_s5_47: Anji blinked twice, harboring not the slightest suspicion toward two ace surgeons notorious for splitting hairs at the table, and glanced straight down at the OR schedule sheet in her hand:
nodes.em4_s5_48: "Let me check… No problem! Room Two has no afternoon cases booked after this. I'll give the housekeeping crew a heads-up to wait until you two finish debriefing and step out before they come in to turn the room over. If an emergency call comes through, I'll ring the wall intercom!"
nodes.em4_s5_50: With a brisk "Of course—take your time debriefing, Doctors!", Anji tucked her clipboard against her chest and walked off down the hall.
nodes.em4_s5_51: Stepping back inside Operating Room No. 2, Ryuji pressed the interior close switch beside the frame.
nodes.em4_s5_52: The heavy automatic door glided shut, leaving the quiet, spacious operating theater entirely to the two of them.
nodes.em4_s5_53: Standing beside the operating table, Emiko watched him stroll back in with utter composure, half exasperated and half amused:
nodes.em4_s5_54: "…You actually went out there and told Anji that with a straight face? 'Debriefing anatomical details privately'…?"
nodes.em4_s5_55: Ryuji stopped right in front of her, looking down at her with a teasing glint in his smile:
nodes.em4_s5_56: "What else was I supposed to say? Wasn't it Chief Mido herself who ordered me not to leave first today?"
nodes.em4_s6_1_01: Freed from any worry of footsteps opening the door unannounced, the quiet operating room held only the low hum of the climate-controlled ventilation—and the sound of two breaths suddenly drawing close.
nodes.em4_s6_1_03: Turning her head slightly, she let her gaze rest on the narrow, level operating table gleaming cool beneath the dimmed ceiling strips, her fingers tightening and loosening unconsciously. After a two-second pause, the Surgical Chief accustomed to commanding every room lifted her flushed cheeks and spoke the wish she had been turning over in her chest:
nodes.em4_s6_1_04: "…The truth is, I've been thinking about something these past two days."
nodes.em4_s6_1_05: Watching the faint tremor of her lashes, Ryuji asked:
nodes.em4_s6_1_07: "Before, every time I stepped off the table, I stayed behind here alone… doing it by myself in an empty room."
nodes.em4_s6_1_08: Her voice dropped low, threaded with rare shyness yet bold enough to pull the chest tight:
nodes.em4_s6_1_09: "But standing in the lead spot earlier looking across at you, one thought kept running through my head… If I weren't alone in here today—if it were with you… right here on this operating table, what would that actually feel like?"
nodes.em4_s6_1_10: As the words fell, she stared straight at Ryuji with ears burning crimson, waiting for his answer.
nodes.em4_s6_1_11: Following her gaze, Ryuji gave the narrow, surgical-spec operating table beside them a thorough, measured appraisal, rubbed his chin, and remarked deadpan:
nodes.em4_s6_1_12: "An operating table is a bed, sure—just a bit on the narrow side."
nodes.em4_s6_1_13: The air went dead silent for one full second.
nodes.em4_s6_1_14: Emiko blinked once, then widened her eyes slightly as though stung into a laugh by so relentlessly practical an assessment:
nodes.em4_s6_1_15: "…I spell things out to this point, and the first thing you evaluate is the width of the bed?!"
nodes.em4_s6_1_16: Ryuji laughed and closed the half-step between them:
nodes.em4_s6_1_17: "Weren't you the one who proposed using it first? I have to assess the working clearance—if things get lively in a minute and one of us rolls off the edge, the whole hospital really will know what we were 'debriefing' tomorrow."
nodes.em4_s6_1_18: That half-serious, half-teasing remark shattered the very last trace of stiff restraint in the room.
nodes.em4_s6_1_19: The flush across Emiko's cheeks spread all the way to her collarbones, yet her cool, striking eyes rippled with unyielding defiance and unmistakable desire. Rather than backing away, she took half a step back on her own, perched lightly onto the cool edge of the operating table, and reached out to catch the collar of Ryuji's scrub top:
nodes.em4_s6_1_20: "Isn't narrow all the better… saves you from drifting too far away in a minute."
nodes.em4_s6_1_21: Her fingers burned against his collar, her upturned gaze at once proud and completely unguarded:
nodes.em4_s6_1_22: "You're the one who borrowed this half hour outside, Dr. Sakaguchi. …Care to come here and find out?"
nodes.em4_s6_1_23: Closing his hands over hers at his collar, Ryuji leaned down to press a kiss to the warm corner of her lips:
nodes.em4_s6_2_01: There was no telling how much time passed before the tangled, breathless gasps inside Operating Room No. 2 subsided bit by bit.
nodes.em4_s6_2_02: Pulling his scrubs back on first, Ryuji reached out to steady Emiko where she still sat catching her breath on the edge of the operating table. Taking a clean tissue to dab the fine sweat from her fingertips and the side of her neck, Emiko slipped back into her scrub pants and top, lifting both hands to gather her tousled hair neatly behind her head once more.
nodes.em4_s6_2_03: A lingering rose still colored her cheeks and a dewy languor softened the ordinarily cool corners of her eyes, yet her entire bearing looked freer and more deeply satisfied than ever before.
nodes.em4_s6_2_04: Smoothing the collar of her scrub top, Emiko glanced down at the operating table that had just borne the weight of both of them, the corner of her mouth curving upward ever so faintly:
nodes.em4_s6_2_05: "…Hmph. For someone complaining earlier that it was narrow, your performance didn't seem the least bit cramped by the space."
nodes.em4_s6_2_06: Leaning against the side rail, Ryuji answered with an easy grin:
nodes.em4_s6_2_07: "Still a touch narrow, honestly—twice back there, if I hadn't caught you by the waist in time, Chief Mido really might have slid right off the pad."
nodes.em4_s6_2_08: Ears warming, Emiko swatted lightly at the back of his hand resting on the rail:
nodes.em4_s6_2_09: "Spare me the nonsense. My center of gravity is rock solid."
nodes.em4_s6_2_10: After that bit of banter, a quiet two seconds settled over the room.
nodes.em4_s6_2_11: Letting out a soft breath, Emiko leaned lightly against the cool table edge and turned her head toward the man beside her, her voice gentler than usual yet still as candid as the blade she held in surgery:
nodes.em4_s6_2_12: "…I always assumed liking to stay behind and do things like that by myself after surgery was an odd habit I'd have to take to my grave alone. I really did love that secret rush in an empty operating room—that hasn't changed."
nodes.em4_s6_2_13: Her gaze settled into Ryuji's eyes with a newfound lightness that seemed to surprise even her:
nodes.em4_s6_2_14: "I just didn't expect that once I stopped hiding it from you—once I actually pulled you inside this door and did what I'd been wanting to try together… it would feel even better than keeping it all to myself."
nodes.em4_s6_2_15: Looking into her bright, unguarded eyes, Ryuji smiled warmly:
nodes.em4_s6_2_16: "Sounds like Room Two may need the occasional 'two-person post-op debrief' penciled in after future cases, then?"
nodes.em4_s6_2_17: Emiko shot him a sidelong glance without denying it, hopping cleanly off the operating table onto her feet and resuming her crisp, upright posture:
nodes.em4_s6_2_18: "Depends on how you perform at the table—and what our after-hours schedules look like."
nodes.em4_s6_2_19: Side by side, the two walked toward the door to head out and change back into their daily white coats.
nodes.em4_s6_2_20: A split second before Ryuji's fingers reached the door release, Emiko called out to him again.
nodes.em4_s6_2_22: Staying his hand, Ryuji looked back:
nodes.em4_s6_2_24: Emiko lifted her chin to meet his eyes. The heady flush from the operating table had faded, and in those cool eyes burned once more the razor-sharp edge of Hoshimi's top Surgical Chief:
nodes.em4_s6_2_25: "Let's get one thing straight up front. I asked you to stay today because I respect the man you are—and because I genuinely wanted to do this with you."
nodes.em4_s6_2_26: "How close we get behind closed doors is one matter—when it comes to the Chief of Surgery post, I won't yield half a step to you over this."
nodes.em4_s6_2_27: Becoming lovers had neither softened her into someone who leaned meekly on a man nor dimmed her claim on the throne by a single fraction.
nodes.em4_s6_2_28: Looking at a woman who could give herself to him without reserve on an operating table one moment and throw down the gauntlet with regal pride the next, Ryuji couldn't help laughing aloud:
nodes.em4_s6_2_29: "Rest easy, Chief Mido. If sharing an operating table made me expect you to pull your punches, you probably would've called me an idiot a second time back in the office."
nodes.em4_s6_2_30: "Best partners across the table, trusted accomplices behind closed doors, and all-out rivals on pure merit for the Chief's chair—I couldn't ask for a better arrangement."
nodes.em4_s6_2_31: Watching him, the cool lines of Emiko's brow finally relaxed completely into a faint, breathtaking smile:
nodes.em4_s6_2_32: "Good that we understand each other. …Come on. Stay in here any longer and Anji really will think we're drafting a paper."
nodes.em4_s6_2_33: The automatic door glided softly open.
nodes.em4_s6_2_34: One after the other, the two surgeons stepped out of Operating Room No. 2 and blended composedly back into the afternoon rhythm of Hoshimi Hospital—except that behind the door no one had ever been allowed past before, there was finally one person welcome to stay.
